The word and word-pair frequency tables (assets/dict_*.bin, assets/bigrams_*.bin) were
computed from the OpenSubtitles2018 monolingual corpora distributed by OPUS
(https://opus.nlpl.eu/OpenSubtitles.php).

P. Lison and J. Tiedemann, 2016, OpenSubtitles2016: Extracting Large Parallel Corpora from
Movie and TV Subtitles. In Proceedings of the 10th International Conference on Language
Resources and Evaluation (LREC 2016).

The tables contain only aggregate counts, no subtitle text.
